_source: IBM Quantum Platform public backend-properties API (QiskitRuntimeService.backend(name).properties()); values are typical published magnitudes for IBM's superconducting transmon QPUs (e.g. ibm_brisbane / ibm_kingston class, Eagle/Heron processors), used as an OFFLINE fallback when no live IBM_QUANTUM_API_TOKEN is configured.
_note: Run ibm_calibration.py with a real token to replace this with a live pull and it will cache the fresh values here with a fetch timestamp.
